messages.text: Your refund proposal is for BRL 93.50. Please confirm it using the button on the proposal card; replying “yes” in chat won’t confirm it. Once confirmed, a staff member will review the request.

messages.text: The staff member rejected the refund request because the returned bag has a stain on the strap. No money will be paid.
